notes.title: v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/d0af9d626e89069b40d7a4487ad439e094933850.png[/img]

[h1]Highlights:[/h1]
[list]
[*]5 new maps + map reworks
[*]Surf changes
[*]Leaderboard reset
[*]New netcode
[*]New anti-cheat
[*]New floor detection
[*]Startup optimizations
[*]Replays record pre-run
[*]New end-of-game voting
[*]Close Characters fade out
[*]Map Pools (supporter only)
[/list]

[b]For version 1.1's release the Supporter Bundle is 25% off for the weekend[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469980/SurfsUp__Supporter_Bundle/

[h1]New Maps[/h1]
[list]
[*]SnowGlobe by Spanky (1 Star)
[*]Spkneon by Spanky (2 Star)
[*]Crinkle by conkin (3 Star)
[*]Fragmented by soh (4 Star)
[*]Stone by soh (5 Star)
[/list]

[h1]Surf Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Max surf speed reduced from 12.192 -> 8.128
[*]Max speed at start reduced from 466 -> 350
[*]Ground acceleration reduced from 10 -> 5
[*]Max walk speed in spawn set to 320
These changes were made to be more in-line with other Source engine surf games. I plan to experiment with surf changes each "season" and plan to reset leaderboards to accommodate changes.
[/list]

[h1]Leaderboards Reset[/h1]

With the changes to speed the old records are now unachiveable. The leaderboards have been 'soft-reset,' the old scores still remain in the backend and will be featured on the website in the future.

[h1]New Netcode[/h1]

Thanks to the changes made to the SteamMultiplayerPeer, we've implemented entirely new net code! Hopefully this should make for more stable and consistent network connections, with the potential for larger lobbies

[h1]New Anti-cheat[/h1]

Without going into [i]too much[/i] detail, the game now checks integrity and validates multiple variables during game play. There is potential for false flags, if you get falsely kicked to main menu with an integrity error please report it to the [url=https://discord.gg/95XmYfPnwV]Discord server[/url]

[h1]Replays record pre-start[/h1]

Replays now record the first 3 seconds before a run begins, but also immediately start when a run begins so you can still race a ghost from timed tick zero.

[h1]New Floor Detection[/h1]

The game now detects when the surfer is on a floor differently. Instead of relying on Godot's [i]is_on_floor[/i] and a 3-strike system, we now use a 5 raycast system with instant resets. This allows players to not be reset when riding the spine of a ramp, and will hopefully be more reliable when colliding with certain angles and floors.

[h1]Startup Optimizations[/h1]

The game now displays a "Loading Surfsup" screen on boot. Player models now load asynchronously instead of during boot.

[h1]HUD rewritten[/h1]

The game's HUD has been entirely refactored and separated from the surfer. This allows us to start accessing, hiding, and [i](in the future)[/i] moving and sizing individual HUD elements.

[h1]Map Pools (supporter only)[/h1]

A new feature added for supporters is "Map Pools." When hosting a game you can now select [i]which maps[/i] you want in your rotation.

[h2]New Host Game UI[/h2]

With the new map pools there's a new host game UI for selecting maps.

[h2]Lobby & Map settings now save and load[/h2]

Previously selected map(s) and lobby settings now save and load locally.

[h2]Map Authors added[/h2]

The map authors have been added to the level select and player menu (TAB)

[h1]Character Distance Fade[/h1]

Characters now fade when close to the camera and cull their back face so you no longer see 'inside' of players' models and models close to the camera will dither away

[h1]New end-game map vote[/h1]

The map end-game voting now shows 4 options for votes and the count of votes by all players per map

[h1]New Supporter DLC Banner[/h1]

Non-supporters will see a banner promoting the Supporter DLC on the main menu

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[list]
[*][i]hide_chat[/i] console command
[*]Paint / Clear paint now bindable
[*]Prev / Next saveloc defaults to [i], / .[/i] now
[*]Max checkpoints have been increased to 50
[*]Lobby chat now persists between map changes
[*]0.000 second times now show as DNF (did not finish)
[/list]

[h1]Map Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ascension: Backwards skip blocked
[*]Stormy: Now symmetrical
[*]Strafe Course: Now has a ceiling
[*]Glowhop: Walls extended to edge
[*]Christmas: Sleigh collision removed
[*]Nebula: Reworked and boxed in
[*]Kitsune: Savelocs re-enabling timer fixed
[*]Summit: Out of bound skip fixed
[*]Lavahop: End zone platform position fixed to be inline with the zone
[*]Fix Settings Panel on Boreas
[*]Fix Settings Panel on Mesa
[*]Optimized Prism
[*]Skip Blocks on Mesa Revo
[*]Fiellu: Cleaned Up Ramps, Light, Bake VoxelGI, and add Settings Panel.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.9.641 Patch Notes - F2P & New Zoning
notes.notes:
[h1]Surfsup.website[/h1]

I have registered a domain for the game, https://surfsup.website
In the future, this will be a website featuring leaderboards, map rotation, user profiles, and more. I am also [b]interested in working on this with the community[/b] so if you would like to help, please make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/95XmYfPnwV]SurfsUp Discord Server.[/url]

[h1]Free-to-Play Model[/h1]

With NextFest and the [b]v1.0 demo[/b] coming up, we have implemented the free-to-play model into SurfsUp. There are [b]13 available maps per day[/b] rotating [b]every 24 hours.[/b] The [b]7 ported maps will always be included[/b] in the available maps. You can now only select cosmetics that are available in your Steam inventory. [b]Cosmetics will reset back to default[/b] when loading the patch. A timer now shows on the main menu letting you know when maps will rotate. [b]All maps become available[/b] when you purchase the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3469980/SurfsUp__Supporter_Bundle/]supporter bundle[/url][/b]. 

I am looking for feedback on this model, so please let me know what you think on the Discord server!

[h1]Zoning Reworked[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/b1fb5356860148c2788223e3059f1832d4b11cd7.png[/img]
After discussion with some members of the community, we have [b]rezoned every map in the game.[/b]

Zones are now a "box collider" where the timer begins as soon as you exit the area. Previously the starting line was a horizontal world boundary, this allowed players to pre-hop further into the map and start a few seconds ahead of others. This change makes the competition [i][b]fair for all[/b][/i] now having the same starting location for every player.

Zones are outlined with a mesh wire-frame, Green for start zones, red for end zones, and blue or grey to represent invisible walls in the maps.

'Show Zones' is now enabled by default, but can be disabled in Game Settings or using the console command [code]showzones false[/code]

Due to the zoning changes, [b]all leaderboards have been reset[/b]

[h1]New Map: AirControl[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/910035b7bde8d534d72580bf03a5f130773d80a8.png[/img]
AirControl is a new ported 1-star map, it has been re-lit and re-textured for SurfsUp and is a long and forgiving map with multiple ramps aimed towards beginners.

[h1]New Map: Forest[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/f29bdc62ae15fa5bfbc937dfed890d10d534457b.png[/img]
Forest is a new map by community member [b]Raq[/b], it is a 3-star map with multiple routes to a single end-zone.

[h1]New Community Map: SoulSearch[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/7c801b6fdb38b8ae0582d067fa85a4172b891dd1.png[/img]
SoulSearch is a new 4-star map created by community member [b]500 Ping[/b] using the [url=https://bearlikelion.github.io/SurfsUpSDK/]SurfsUp SDK[/url] Project! It features multiple routes with various paths, each path being quicker than the last.

[h1]Crouching recoded[/h1]

[i]Crouching before:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/ecb57b637fa4dd03f448738294b65bb75f58368b.gif[/img]
There have been some issues with the character's crouching. Previously, it had a 0.4s delay for "is_ducking" to the "ducked" state. The entire code for crouching has been rewritten to now be instant and to keep the same collision shape on the character instead of replacing it with a new one.

[i]Crouching after:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416259/6b378292d880142d6787800cd46dc9b9309d0155.gif[/img]

[h1]New Music[/h1]

[b]Raqqit[/b]: Down the Rabbit Hole by spineywoodchuck
[b]Ruins[/b]: Explore the Ruins by spineywoodchuck

[h1]Dev Console[/h1]

New console command [i]disconnect[/i] to leave a lobby
New console alias [i]load[/i] for [i]map[/i] to load custom maps
New console alias [i]qqq[/i] for [i]quit[/i] and [i]exit[/i]
Opening console enables [i]is_typing[/i] so character no longer moves when typing in console
Console will capture mouse again when closing in-game

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Surfer: Model, Animation, Player Color, and Trail color now synchronize on the network
[*]Option menu defaults to [i]Game Options[/i] again
[*]Fixed changing a player's color changing [i]all player's[/i] color
[*]If jump is bound to mouse scroll you will no longer jump when scrolling elements in the UI
[*]Moving the mouse while holding down a mouse button while spectating will no longer changes who you are spectating every frame
[*]Leaving spectator mode no longer freezes the player in the [i]is_typing[/i] state
[*]Various netcode optimizations
[*]Starting lines removed from all levels
[*]Map Voting RPC moved out of the UI Scripts and into the NetCode
[*]Various textures have been replaced in the game that referenced licensed / adult themes
[*]Stretch Mode now properly sets the saved setting on load
[*]Fullscreen now properly sets the saved setting on load
[*]Game should now properly launch in full screen on first launch
[/list]

As a reminder, [b]the beta will be ending on May 18th 2025.[/b] We will be revoking [i]all beta keys[/i] and transitioning to the v1.0 demo which will be releasing [b]May 30th[/b] on Steam.

Thank you all for playing and providing feedback.
-Mark
